study_identification_part.si_3_author_journal_year: Meijer et al., Journal of Psychopathology and Clinical Science, 2024
study_identification_part.si_4_title: Toward Understanding Autism Heterogeneity: Identifying Clinical Subgroups and Neuroanatomical Deviations

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: The study used warped likelihood Bayesian Linear Regression (BLR) with SinArcsinh likelihood warping and 3-knot B-spline, implemented in the PCNtoolkit (Version 0.26) in Python. The warping allows calculation of error measures in warped space and description of deviations under Gaussian error distribution.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: Here, we performed normative modelling using the PCNtoolkit (version 0.26) in Python (version 3.9.16). We used a 3-knot B-spline Bayesian Linear Regression (BLR) model with SinArcinh likelihood warping and Powell optimisation, allowing us to calculate error measures in a warped space and describe deviations under a Gaussian error distribution (Fraza et al., 2021; Rutherford et al., 2022).

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Cortical thickness (CT) was extracted using the Destrieux parcellation scheme (148 ROIs, 74 regions per hemisphere). Subcortical volumes were obtained from the FreeSurfer volume-based stream using the ASEG atlas (23 subcortical ROIs).
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: Here, we performed normative modeling on CT and subcortical regions of interests (ROIs) using warped likelihood Bayesian Linear Regression... CT was extracted for each individual using the Destrieux parcellation scheme consisting of 74 regions in each hemisphere... A separate normative model was built for each of the 148 CT ROIs and 23 subcortical ROIs independently.
nm2_2_response_variable.location: Meijer2024.pdf.md: Method / Normative Modeling; Method / Image Processing

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Covariates included age, site, FIQ (full-scale intelligence quotient), and the Euler number (image quality measure). Intracranial volume (ICV) was additionally included for subcortical volume normative modeling.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: Included covariates in the normative model were age, site, FIQ, and the Euler number and also intracranial volume for the subcortical volume based normative modeling.
